'''Tu'rsc'yulir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who set up a processing station near the [[Yawari Cliffs]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. She was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Kintan Gunrunners]].<ref name="Tessent" />
